authority.user_instruction: Continue from the latest verified checkpoint, implement one bounded measurable improvement at a time, bind workflow authority to an operator-approved manifest digest outside the repository, and expose a stable machine-readable CLI before any reusable Codex skill.

scope.objective: Freeze and implement IncidentSeal's versioned manifest authority and machine-readable host CLI contract with deterministic, fail-closed behavior before introducing the Compose runtime.
forbidden_work: Allowing repository content or an agent-facing command to create or replace operator approval
Pulling, running, or redistributing a candidate image outside its approved gate
Adding a third-party dependency before a separate source gate
Starting the Compose, PostgreSQL, runner, dashboard, or release implementation before the CLI and manifest contracts pass
Claiming an unverified real product surface
reversible_actions: Create and edit repository contracts, schemas, fixtures, source, tests, and documentation
Create an isolated test approval store outside the repository under the project test harness
Run dependency-free local validation and mutation tests
Commit and push verified bounded improvements
stop_conditions: A proposed change alters the approved product promise or trust boundary
The external approval boundary cannot fail closed
A dependency is required without a ready source gate
A stable machine contract requires an unresolved product choice
A checkpoint cannot be verified locally and after push

units.purpose: Freeze the versioned manifest schema, canonicalization rules, digest approval boundary, stable CLI commands, exit codes, JSON schemas, and mutation vectors as dependency-free machine contracts.
inputs: Current Codex AGENTS.md and non-interactive JSON guidance
retained_failures: The shell safety policy blocked an ad-hoc PowerShell mutation harness before execution; no state changed and a repository-owned Python harness replaced it.
The first hash inventory used an unavailable System.IO.Path.GetRelativePath API; no state changed.
The second hash inventory omitted the fixtures/contracts path segment; the corrected explicit inventory succeeded.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The dependency-free contract freeze passed supported-subset, fixture, digest, cross-process, and mutation gates. It releases implementation but does not yet prove a real CLI, a full Draft 2020-12 meta-schema check, or the operator approval store.

units.purpose: Implement dependency-free manifest parsing, schema checks, canonicalization, SHA-256 digesting, and stable CLI envelopes.
retained_failures: A wildcard py_compile invocation failed because Windows passed the wildcard literally; the explicit-path rerun passed.
The shell safety policy blocked generated-cache cleanup before execution; caches remain ignored and untracked.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The real dependency-free lint and digest commands now satisfy the frozen contract for their bounded surface and release the external approval-store implementation. Full checkpoint exits remain pending until approval, mutation, and clean-copy gates pass.

units.purpose: Implement and probe the operator-owned approval store outside repository custody, with inspect and compare available to agents but approval replacement unavailable through agent-facing paths.
retained_failures: The initial Windows temporary-custody run returned INVALID for five positive comparison cases because user control was represented by OWNER RIGHTS; owner verification and bounded OWNER RIGHTS handling corrected it, and the full rerun passed.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The read-only external approval boundary distinguishes all five statuses, rejects unsafe custody and agent writes, and releases deterministic fail-closed mutation evaluation. No real approval or execution authority exists.

units.purpose: Run deterministic golden-vector, malformed-input, policy-drift, stale-approval, ambiguous-approval, and repository-tampering mutation evaluations.
retained_failures: The first retained-record equivalence rerun used a one-second shell timeout and was terminated before the matrix finished; no state changed, and the measured-allowance rerun passed all 50 executions and matched the retained record.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: All 25 fail-closed scenarios produced their expected distinct product state or stable rejection in two trials, for 50 passing executions without a real approval.

units.purpose: Implement the already-specified operator-only interactive approval writer with fixed external custody, restrictive permissions, atomic replacement, and retained superseded records; validate only in isolated temporary custody.
retained_failures: The first final JSON check used a no-space PowerShell redirection token that was parsed as part of the filename; the parser did not run, no approval state changed, and the corrected invocation passed.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The frozen operator-only write surface now requires a real terminal and full digest, uses fixed restrictive custody and atomic compare-and-swap replacement, retains exact superseded bytes, and rejects non-interactive and concurrent-change paths.

units.purpose: Validate the packaged local CLI contract from a clean temporary copy without Docker runtime use.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The manifest, approval, operator-write, and fail-closed evaluation units passed; clean temporary-copy real-CLI validation is now the sole eligible unit.

units.purpose: Commit, push, and live-verify the bounded IS-0002 checkpoint without making a software-release claim.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Pending all prior IS-0002 exit conditions.
